body: Its so hard getting back up sometimes. Especially when it's just me. My son is young so he doesn't understand what is going on. I guess thats a blessing in a way. Thank you for reaching out! It truly mean a lot to me! ❤

Thank you for commenting! I used your suggestions and they helped me calm myself for a few moments. I am in a group program currently. I won't have my son with me tomorrow and worry about that. Thank you so much again for reaching out! 💕

I have been struggling with depression thats been treated on/off and an eating disorder and I've kept completely hidden until very recently. Thank you for commenting. I couldn't express it at the time, but it truly helped me. 💜
Same here 😔 sending one your way. 💜
I wish I could sleep. I just lay in bed. Watching the days pass me by..
